claims.claim: FormFactor Q2 2026 revenue reached a record $258.2M, up 31.9% year over year, with strength in DRAM, foundry/logic and systems; management specifically linked sequential growth to HBM and co-packaged optics initiatives.

The company also reported a multi-year Keystone Microtech partnership expanding probe-card manufacturing and test capabilities in Taiwan, adding execution capacity in a strategically important semiconductor ecosystem.

risks.risk: HBM/CPO growth exposure remains tied to semiconductor capital and product-cycle timing; record quarterly results do not establish cycle durability.

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration and incremental economics of the Keystone partnership are not established by this source.

claims.claim: Record revenue and above-outlook profitability indicate strong current execution, while HBM and CPO provide source-addressed growth vectors that should be tested against future semiconductor-cycle and customer-concentration evidence.

risks.risk: Strong current demand may be cyclical rather than structural.

unknowns.unknown: Forward order visibility and customer-level dependence require additional primary evidence.
